test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The captain dropped the trophy while he ________the victory with his teammates.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires **the past continuous tense to indicate an action that was ongoing at the time another action occurred.**
 
• The **past continuous tense** is formed using **"was/were" + the present participle (verb + -ing).**
 
• In this case, **"was celebrating" **correctly indicates that the celebration was in progress when the trophy was dropped.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The captain dropped the trophy while he **was celebrating** the victory with his teammates."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "celebrated"** – This is the simple past tense, which does not convey the ongoing nature of the action.
 
• **Option 3: "is celebrating"** – This is the present continuous tense, which is not appropriate for past events.
 
• **Option 4: "celebrates"** – This is the simple present tense, which is not appropriate for past events.
